review: Methods, variable appendix, baseline and alternative-estimator tables inspected; not a claim to have replicated the original dataset.

baseline.equation: Liquidity_i,c,t+1 = beta MandatoryDisclosure_c,t + X_i,c,t-1 theta + firm FE + industry-by-year FE
outcomes: log annual median Amihud price impact
baseline.timing: 12 months following fiscal year end; policy status in t, outcome t+1, controls t-1
baseline.inference: Firm clustering in baseline; alternative clustering in robustness
baseline.screening: Annual spread outside [0,1] missing; price impact requires >=120 observations and price variation; annual spread/impact winsorized at 1/99.
baseline.esg_definition: Complete mandatory E, S and G; staggered topic introduction requires all three. Comply-or-explain is mandatory in baseline.

table8.stack_definition: Clean never/not-yet-treated controls, firm-by-stack and year-by-stack effects; uses pre/post observations.

adaptation.unit: Country means of fixed companies; no claim to reproduce firm financial controls, fiscal-year timing or industry-by-year effects.
adaptation.outcomes: Three original individual proxies plus baseline-2000 standardized equal-sign illiquidity index; index is not the reference latent factor.
adaptation.stack_FE: Country-by-family-cohort and year-by-family-cohort. Controls must remain documented not-yet treated through entire window; unknown histories excluded.
adaptation.all_disclosures: Ten public families, combined eleven including confidential tax, and all recorded seventeen as broader sensitivity.
adaptation.pooling: Direct stacked slopes and explicit family averages target different exposure distributions. GLS is a conditional common-effect minimum-distance diagnostic, not a cure for confounding or a direct SUR replication.
